verdict.rationale: The evidence centers on the Dataverse Web API, which works with any language that can send authenticated HTTP requests. It only implies an official SDK through a passing reference to avoiding 'a dependency on a specific NuGet package', and for other languages it points developers to third-party libraries to generate classes. That third-party route is not an official SDK, so credit rests on a thin, indirect mention. Missing for 10: a named official SDK with documentation, official SDKs in multiple languages (e.g. Python/JS), SDK install and usage docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You might want to use the Web API when you don't want to take a dependency on a specific NuGet package
